verdict.rationale: An official MCP server is a plausible offering for a SaaS tax platform like Anrok, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows that the Headless Tax APIs can be 'handed to your agents,' with no mention of an official MCP server, endpoint, or setup docs. That makes it adjacent API access rather than the capability itself.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Run tax through Anrok's APIs, or hand it to your agents.
